concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-customer-update-node]] - Node.js customer updates with unchanged omitted attributes, existing-credit-card versus new-payment-method behavior, billing-address update semantics, default-payment-method selection, verification qualifications, and a retained missing non-card update route
warnings: Preserve that omitted customer attributes remain unchanged; do not generalize this to nested option omission where the page explicitly describes creation or reassociation effects.

Distinguish updating an existing credit card from creating a new credit card or associating a new payment method of any type; do not claim the customer-update method updates existing non-card payment methods.
Keep default-payment-method selection separate from payment-method creation and existing-card update behavior.
Preserve that validation runs by default while verification does not, and keep both the account-wide verification and Premium Fraud Management Tools device_data language advisory and conditional.

Do not reconstruct the missing method or destination after `use.` in the collected non-card update note, and do not treat linked validation, response-object, payment-method, or Control Panel pages as fully read evidence.
